SYMPTOM: User still gets prompted in terminal to approve 'safe' commands (Read, standard Bash) even though tool-classifier marks them as autoApprove: true.

CAUSE: pre-tool-use route returns empty `{}` or `new Response(null, {status: 200})` for auto-approved commands. Claude Code treats any response without `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision` as 'no opinion' and falls back to its own approval prompt.

FIX NEEDED: For auto-approved commands, return:
```json
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Auto-approved"}}
```

FILE: `/Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/pixel-office/src/app/api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts`
Look for the `autoApprove` branch and ensure it returns the full permissionDecision JSON, not empty body.

NOTE: The no-browser fallthrough (return empty 200) is CORRECT behavior — only the auto-approve code path needs fixing. Don't confuse the two.
